cards.title: codebase: CI on pull requests (M)
cards.body:
from docs/CODEBASE_PLAN.md (Oct 22), 1. Safety net first (nothing else is safe to change without it). may already be partly done: check before starting.

cards.title: codebase: Stage build time (M)
cards.body:
from docs/CODEBASE_PLAN.md (Oct 22), 3. Optimizations. may already be partly done: check before starting.

7 s for 3 mi, 16-20 s for 12 mi headless: terrain mesh 1.6 s, road mesh 1.8 s, scenery 2.5 s, trees 0.4 s. The scenery and road mesh builds are pure data work: move array building to `WorkerThreadPool` (meshes are committed on the main thread), and chunk the endurance case so the loading screen keeps animating (the new live loading screen shows how much it stutters today).

cards.title: codebase: Tire curve cost (S)
cards.body:
from docs/CODEBASE_PLAN.md (Oct 22), 3. Optimizations. may already be partly done: check before starting.

The Magic Formula adds one `atan` and one `sin` per wheel per substep (4 wheels x 8 substeps x 120 Hz). Measure with `physics_rate_test`; if it matters, a 256-entry lookup per (C, E) shape (cached already) is exact enough and cheaper.

cards.title: codebase: Break up the giants (L, incremental)
cards.body:
from docs/CODEBASE_PLAN.md (Oct 22), 4. Structure and docs. may already be partly done: check before starting.

Follow the pattern the code already uses (`car_damage.gd`, `body_panels.gd`, `aero_parts.gd` are preload modules owned by `Car`): extract from `car.gd` the suspension / geometry (`_setup_geo`, `_geo_jacks`), steering assist + rack glue, intake / heat, and net-state; from `race.gd` the start sequence (`_rolling_start`, `_formation`), results / wire / telemetry; from `ai_driver.gd` the crash / jump / rails code; from `track_generator.gd` `_gen_*` layouts. One module per PR, behavior pinned by the existing tests; never mix a move with a change.
